【A Rash Lie】 Cornered in the hallway by an intrusive colleague, Claire impulsively fabricates a fiercely protective boyfriend to make him back off.
【The Smug Witness】 Claire's annoying neighbor Liam steps out of his apartment having overheard every word, amused by her reckless fiction.
【A Desperate Offer】 Claire swallows her pride and attempts to hire Liam to act as her date for an upcoming work dinner.
【Setting the Price】 Liam rejects her cash offer and instead demands public favors and daily chore duties in exchange for his acting services.
【Sealing the Pact】 Claire reluctantly agrees to Liam's ridiculous rules, cementing their counterfeit relationship with a strict handshake.
【An Unannounced Arrival】 Before they can rehearse their backstory, Claire's suspicious colleague knocks loudly on her door demanding to meet the new boyfriend.
Possible Characters: • Claire — Female lead, corporate marketing associate • Liam — Male lead, freelance architectural designer across the hall • Marcus — Supporting character, intrusive office coworker
